evidence.excerpt: We run the first controlled deployment-value comparison: at equal budget, a VAL-guided stack (confirmation gate + schema sandbox) versus a mainstream intuition stack (prompt hardening + keyword filter), 50 scenarios, 12 attack variants, adaptive/white-box/PAIR escalation (~7,000 testbed calls; ~10,000 harness calls on AgentDojo/JADE).

declaredVenue: v1: applies Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL) to 22 agent-security defenses; first controlled deployment-value comparison (VAL-guided vs intuition stack) across three testbeds; ~17k LLM calls; an honest out-of-ODD boundary is reported. Writing was assisted by an AI language model; all experiments and research decisions are the author's own
